description: '!' is the only read-before-merging signal a consuming cluster gets: modules are consumed at
PINNED tags, and at 0.x '!' cuts a minor instead of a silent patch. The bot cannot read
release notes, so the marker is structural: every module-path major (the shared preset does
this), plus the two dependencies whose minors historically broke operators (rule below).
Not a claim that every such bump breaks, but that a bot may not decide it does not.
Do not re-add a local majors rule: kubernetes-api migrations group into one PR spanning
many modules, where no module scope is true (.claude/rules/commits.md, rule 3 over 4).
A bare 'BREAKING CHANGE' body is absent everywhere: the bare token parses as nothing, and
'!' in the header is what release-please reads (.claude/rules/commits.md, 'Breaking
changes').
Flux and Longhorn ship operator-affecting changes in minor releases (a Flux minor can
require a CRD/API migration; a Longhorn minor, an upgrade path), and the shared preset
marks only majors -- so this marker is hand-built. The scope is {{semanticCommitScope}} by
reference, never re-derived from the path. Module paths only, deliberately: a flux CLI pin
elsewhere ships nothing.
The shared preset marks every major '!'; here that renders chore(github-actions)!:, which
commitlint rejects: '!' cuts a release, and these surfaces ship nothing.
'' is the UNSET spelling: Renovate's guard tests falsiness, so the plain semantic header
returns.
No matchUpdateTypes: the strip follows the marker if the preset moves it.
components/** and ci/test/** stay marked: majors there reach shipped modules.
